turns.text: I ordered a custom print of the house where I grew up. It arrived Monday and I'd like to return it.
I'm sorry to hear the print didn't work out. To look at your order and the return, please send your order number (it looks like SC-1234) and the email address you used to place the order.
That's SC-2214. The checkout email was rowan.bellwick@example.com.

Thank you, Rowan. I found order SC-2214 for The House Behind the Mulberry Gate, 50x70 cm, delivered on 16 November 2026. I'm sorry, but I can't file a return for it. Our return policy covers catalogue prints only, and this was a custom commissioned piece, so returns aren't allowed for it. If the print arrived damaged or not as described, please tell me what is wrong and I can file a damage claim for staff to review.

items.title: The House Behind the Mulberry Gate

rule.ro: Printurile din catalog se pot returna în 14 zile de la livrare. Clientul plătește transportul retur. Rambursarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery. The customer pays the return postage. Staff must approve the refund.
